findings.title: Amendment-row test (a) reads the live protocol and breaks once a real AM1 is recorded
findings.fix: Use a fixture copy of the v6 §13 section (header only) for the AM1 refusal; separately assert parse_amendment_rows(PROTOCOL) succeeds on the real file.

findings.title: A '|' inside a cause/fix cell makes the whole amendments table unparseable
findings.fix: Split cells on (?<!\\)\| and unescape \| to |; state in protocol §13 that a literal | is written \|; add a §14 case.

findings.title: rescore writes DONE.json from the current lc_manifest.json without checking it is unchanged since training
findings.where: design §12.3 evaluation-only failure branch and rescore
findings.fix: Record lc_manifest_sha256 in eval-stage FAILED.json; rescore refuses (exit 2, lc_manifest_changed_after_failure) on mismatch; add §15 cell and §14 case.
